name: JitoSOL (Jito Liquid Staking)

requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key
A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
Bypass paths of the delay checked and ruled out
Price feed not under one hand
No key shared with another tracked protocol

exit_window: none: a change applies at once

narrative.summary: New pool code could move all stake, and that path is the SPL Stake Pool upgrade committee (6 of 10, no delay). The pool's own roles are bounded: fee changes are delayed or capped, and no human key can mint JitoSOL.
narrative.detail: The pool manager is the native treasury of the Jito DAO governance (council threshold 51% of a council mint of 7 tokens, 5-day vote, 2-day cool-off, no hold-up); its fee changes take effect two epochs later or are capped, and WithdrawStake stays permissionless. The staker is a Steward program account and the stake deposit authority an Interceptor program account. The mint authority is the pool's withdraw PDA. The scorer re-reads these roles on every run and skips the target if one changed. DefiLlama listed over $900M TVL on 2026-09-17.

cheapest_fix.what: admin power taken away from a bare key

independent_read.path: account owned by program SPoo1Ku8… -> program -> ProgramData EmiU8A… -> upgrade authority (a program-derived address, off the curve: a Squads vault or a protocol PDA, no key can sign for it directly)
independent_read.posture: admin: a program-derived address (not a Squads v4 vault); delay: unknown
